instruction: Sabrina and I have been carpooling to work this month. They have requested money for it on venmo. Accept it.
notes: Only supervisor and venmo are needed: the received-payment-request listing already exposes the sender's name, so no phone contact lookup is modeled. The lookup action venmo-show-received-payment-requests (access_token, query) discovers the id of the pending carpooling request from Sabrina (status may additionally be filtered with 'pending' at call time); venmo-approve-payment-request then approves it, which is the single updated PaymentRequest the evaluation expects (approved_at set, denied_at null, amount = carpooling cost). Side effects of approval (venmo.Transaction, Notification, BankTransfer, gmail receipt emails, file_system receipt files) are automatic and not modeled. supervisor-complete-task takes the approved request as a non-API record parameter so its precondition mirrors the goal; no answer is passed since the task asks no question.
